stem: A finished batch is outside acceptance after verified measurement. The recipe version is current, source-water data are abnormal, and all recorded additions match the work order. What is the strongest conclusion?
choices: The evidence supports investigating the changed source water while holding the batch under the authorized disposition process
The recipe should be changed immediately for all future batches
The batch should be released because additions were correct
rationale: Correct execution does not guarantee acceptance when an input condition changes. The batch should remain controlled while the changed source-water condition is investigated.
